lifecycles.name: Receipt
lifecycles.description: Simple cash-receipt flow: post then pay. Used by POS receipts, rental deposits, school receipts.

lifecycles.name: Sales document
lifecycles.description: Order-to-cash flow: submit → approve → post → pay, with cancels from any pre-effects state (rev 4: cancel-vs-reverse, §3.6).

lifecycles.name: Purchase document
lifecycles.description: Procure-to-pay flow: confirm → post → pay → close.

lifecycles.name: Contract / agreement
lifecycles.description: Contractual flow with a long-lived active state (rental agreements, service contracts).

lifecycles.name: Certificate / letter
lifecycles.description: Issue-and-revoke flow for certificates, letters, report cards.

lifecycles.name: Approval-gated document
lifecycles.description: Sales flow with an explicit approval gate at posting (school fee invoices, service orders).

types.name: Sales Invoice
types.description: Universal sales document (POS counter sales and manual invoicing).

types.name: Credit Note
types.description: Reversal counterpart of a sales invoice (CANCELS relation, §3.6).

types.name: Proforma Invoice
types.description: Pre-billing estimate for a sale — no accounting effects.

types.name: POS Receipt
types.description: Thermal receipt issued by the POS terminal at tender.

types.name: Delivery Note
types.description: Goods-out document — inventory effects, no accounting.

types.name: Quotation
types.description: Proposal to a customer — fully editable until accepted.

types.name: Rental Agreement
types.description: Binding lease contract (contract_doc lifecycle). Domain truth lives in the rental module; the DMS only links via DocumentSource.

types.name: Rental Return
types.description: Return-of-unit document — inventory effects; "deposit refund only if returned" is a rental-module rule, never DMS.

types.name: Rental Deposit
types.description: Cash deposit received against an agreement.

types.name: Rental Service Order
types.description: Chargeable service on a rental (cleaning, late fee) — approval-gated.

types.name: School Fee Invoice
types.description: Tuition/fee invoice against a student (school_fee invoice).

types.name: School Receipt
types.description: Payment receipt against fee invoices (or cash).

types.name: Report Card
types.description: Term report card — versioned, re-issued each term change.

relationTypes.name: Converted from
relationTypes.description: Source document that this one was converted from (quotation → sales order → invoice).

relationTypes.name: Generated from
relationTypes.description: Generated from a parent (recurring children, fee invoices from terms).

relationTypes.name: Fulfills
relationTypes.description: Delivery note / GRN fulfills an order or invoice. One fulfill-per-source enforced.

relationTypes.name: Cancels
relationTypes.description: Reversal document cancels the original (credit note → invoice). Implicit inverse maintained.

relationTypes.name: Reissues
relationTypes.description: Phase 6 — reissue reverses a reversal (original → reversal counterpart). Mirror of CANCELS for the reissued doc.

relationTypes.name: Amends
relationTypes.description: New version supersedes the previous issuance (contracts, certificates).

relationTypes.name: Replaces
relationTypes.description: Direct replacement, same type (re-issue of a corrupted/lost document).
